title: Quantum cohomology, Hitchin systems, and Fourier--Mukai comparison
summary: Let $X$ be the moduli space of stable trace-free rank $r$ Higgs bundles over a smooth projective curve $C$ with fixed determinant $Λ\in\Pic(C)$ and $\gcd(r,\degΛ)=1$. We prove that the $\cc^*$-equivariant quantum product of a divisor on $X$ is given by the Steinberg correspondence of the Lagrangian Steinberg cycle in $X\times X$. The Steinberg cycle is the image of the reduced virtual fundamental cycle of the $2$-pointed Kontsevich stable map space to $X$ under evaluation map. For $Γ=\Pic^0(C)[r]$, we give a character decomposition for $Γ$-invariant curve classes or finite orbit sums. In…
